title: HUMAIN launches next-generation horizon ultra AI PC at LEAP 2026, designed with Qualcomm to bring AI directly to the device
summary: Powered by Snapdragon® X2 Elite with an 18-core Qualcomm Oryon™ CPU, Horizon Ultra is the new flagship of the HUMAIN Horizon line bringing CPU, GPU and NPU computing together for on-device AI and launching first with Microsoft Windows

contentHtml:
HUMAIN today launched Horizon Ultra, its next-generation AI PC, at LEAP 2026, unveiling a new personal computing experience designed in collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and powered by the Snapdragon® X2 Elite platform. Image courtesy: HUMAIN

Powered by Snapdragon® X2 Elite with an 18-core Qualcomm Oryon™ CPU, Horizon Ultra is the new flagship of the HUMAIN Horizon line bringing CPU, GPU and NPU computing together for on-device AI and launching first with Microsoft Windows

Press Release

RIYADH, Saudi Arabia – HUMAIN, a PIF company delivering full-stack artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities globally, today launched Horizon Ultra, its next-generation AI PC, at LEAP 2026, unveiling a new personal computing experience designed in collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and powered by the Snapdragon® X2 Elite platform.

The launch follows more than 12 months of design and development by HUMAIN with support from Qualcomm Technologies, focused on building a new generation of personal computing centered on AI that runs directly on the device.

Unveiled for the first time at LEAP, Horizon Ultra is designed to move increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities closer to the user. The first release will run Microsoft Windows, combining a familiar enterprise operating environment with hardware designed for AI. In 2027, the line’s next iteration will introduce HUMAIN OS, extending its AI capabilities further into the personal computing layer.

At the center of Horizon Ultra is Snapdragon X2 Elite, featuring an 18-core Qualcomm Oryon™ CPU alongside the Qualcomm® Adreno™ GPU and Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU. This architecture allows workloads to be distributed across specialized compute engines, enabling advanced AI models and experiences to run locally on the device while seamlessly extending to the cloud when additional scale, compute capacity or services are required.

By bringing dedicated AI processing directly into the PC, Horizon Ultra delivers faster and more responsive AI experiences while allowing selected workloads and sensitive data to remain on the device, supporting privacy and data sovereignty. It creates new possibilities across enterprise productivity, content creation, multimodal AI and intelligent agents, all while staying connected to the cloud whenever a task calls for more power than the device alone can provide.

“The PC is becoming an intelligence platform,” said Tareq Amin, Chief Executive Officer of HUMAIN. “For the past 12 months, HUMAIN and Qualcomm Technologies have been designing for that future by bringing CPU, GPU and NPU together so increasingly powerful AI can run directly on the device. Today at LEAP, we are showing what that future looks like. We begin by capitalizing on our partnership with Microsoft, and in 2027 we take the next step with HUMAIN OS. We are making intelligence native to the device, not simply something the device connects to.”

“AI is rapidly emerging as the new interface for computing,” said Wassim Chourbaji, Senior Vice President and President, Qualcomm Europe, Middle East and Africa, Qualcomm France S.A.R.L. “As devices become increasingly capable of understanding user intent, we are entering an era of intelligent agents. In collaboration with Qualcomm Technologies, HUMAIN has created Horizon Ultra, a platform for this next generation of computing. Powered by Snapdragon X2 Elite with an 18-core CPU, it seamlessly integrates advanced computing performance and on-device AI processing to deliver smarter workflows and more intuitive user experiences.”

For enterprises, Horizon Ultra extends AI from centralized infrastructure to the employee endpoint. Local AI processing can support use cases where responsiveness, connectivity, privacy or data-handling requirements make on-device execution valuable, while maintaining the ability to connect with enterprise and cloud AI environments.

Horizon Ultra is part of HUMAIN’s broader full-stack approach to AI, spanning infrastructure, cloud and compute, data and models, and applications. Extending AI to the personal computing layer creates a new environment where models and applications can operate closer to users and to the work itself.

The planned introduction of HUMAIN OS in 2027 represents the next phase of that roadmap, bringing HUMAIN’s operating environment directly to Horizon Ultra and creating deeper integration between the device, its AI capabilities and HUMAIN’s wider technology platform.

AlFalak will serve as the sales and delivery partner for Horizon Ultra, supporting enterprise purchasing and fulfillment.

Following its unveiling at LEAP 2026,  Horizon Ultra, running Microsoft Windows, will be available for enterprise purchase beginning September 20, 2026.

The launch reflects a broader shift in personal computing as AI moves from being a feature within software to becoming part of the device’s underlying architecture. With dedicated AI processing embedded alongside CPU and GPU compute, the PC is evolving into a platform that runs intelligence, not just one that accesses it.

About HUMAIN

HUMAIN, a PIF company, is a global artificial intelligence company delivering full-stack AI capabilities across four core areas: next-generation data centers; hyper-performance infrastructure and cloud platforms; advanced AI models, including some of the world's most advanced Arabic large language models developed in the Arab world; and transformative AI solutions that combine deep sector insight with real-world execution.

HUMAIN's end-to-end model serves both public and private sector organizations, unlocking value across industries, driving digital transformation, and strengthening capabilities through human–AI collaboration. With a growing portfolio of sector-specific AI products and a core mission focused on intellectual property development and global talent leadership, HUMAIN is engineered for international competitiveness and technological excellence.
